title: chore(pager): set the page size to 50
body:
## Summary
Change _PAGE_SIZE from 100 to 50 in src/pager.py and add tests/test_pager.py asserting that a 200-item input returns 50 rows.

## Rationale
Pages of 100 rows are too large for the narrow display that renders them; 50 rows fit on one screen.

## Testing
Validation plan: run tests/test_pager.py, which expects 50 rows from a 200-item input.

## Limitations
Only src/pager.py is edited; other uses of the page size in the repository are not searched.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/pager.py b/src/pager.py
--- a/src/pager.py
+++ b/src/pager.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-_PAGE_SIZE = 100
+_PAGE_SIZE = 50
 
 
 def page(rows):

diff --git a/tests/test_pager.py b/tests/test_pager.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_pager.py
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from src.pager import page
+
+
+def test_page_length():
+    assert len(page(list(range(200)))) == 50
